bus_client._wire(devices, beat) builds BusDevice() and DeviceRoster(bus), holds BusShim(bus, roster) (BusShim reads only heartbeat.shim_for), then for each named device holds roster.shim_for(name) when not None — no 'ground_loop' special case and no import of the old loop or discovery.discover. It returns (bus, roster). With beat=True it pulses each named shim, then the BusShim, once with datetime.now(timezone.utc) — that is the whole of 'beat' now. reach(*devices) keeps its LookupError for a name with no shim and pulses only the named shims. connect_bus returns bus; connect_system returns (bus, roster); rewrite the three docstrings to say so and drop the beat-cost history paragraphs that describe the loop. web_server/listener.py stays unchanged: 'ground_loop' now resolves through its own shim.py like any other device.
